fields.label: Hero Heading
fields.name: campaign_hero_heading
fields.instructions: Primary expressive headline for the campaign.

fields.label: Hero Subheading / Supporting Copy
fields.name: campaign_hero_subheading
fields.instructions: Clear explanation of the offer and target business outcome.
fields.default_value: A 4-week intensive engineering sprint combining technical SEO teardowns, landing page CRO, and high-intent paid search alignment to maximize enquiry conversion.

fields.label: Hero Image
fields.name: campaign_hero_image
fields.instructions: Editorial visual plate or architectural photography.

fields.label: Offer Introduction Heading
fields.name: campaign_intro_heading
fields.instructions: One-line section title for the executive overview.

fields.label: Offer / Service Introduction
fields.name: campaign_intro_content
fields.instructions: In-depth summary of the campaign proposition and audience requirements.
fields.default_value: Most agency engagements get bogged down in multi-month onboarding without shipping tangible performance improvements. The Q1 Performance Growth Sprint is a tightly scoped 4-week engagement with senior strategists focused entirely on unblocking your enquiry funnel.

fields.label: Sprint Deliverables / Benefits
fields.name: campaign_benefits
fields.instructions: Add each phase or core deliverable for the sprint.

fields.label: Frequently Asked Questions
fields.name: campaign_faqs
fields.instructions: Add questions and answers for prospective sprint clients.

fields.label: CTA Button Text
fields.name: campaign_cta_text
fields.instructions: Label for the primary conversion button.

fields.label: Gravity Forms Form ID
fields.name: campaign_gf_form_id
fields.instructions: Optional Gravity Forms ID to embed in the enquiry section. Leave empty to use default.
